retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy comic book illustration featuring a central character leaping toward the viewer amidst a fiery urban explosion with bold, hand-drawn title lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, low-angle illustration of a red-haired clown character in streetwear leaping forward from a massive orange and yellow explosion. The scene is set in a destroyed city street with debris, wrecked cars, and crumbling buildings, all rendered with thick black outlines and gritty textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Central character leaping forward creates a strong sense of depth and movement.
The massive explosion acts as a high-contrast backdrop to the character's silhouette.
Debris and architectural lines converge toward the center to enhance the focal point.
Bold, arched typography at the top frames the upper composition.
coreInvariants: Thick, expressive black ink outlines on all subjects.
High-saturation warm color palette (reds, oranges, yellows) contrasted with cool blues.
Halftone dot patterns or gritty textures for shading.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main character is centrally located, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame, appearing to jump out at the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's white-painted clown face and the bright core of the explosion behind him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright explosion, follow the character's outstretched arms, and move down to the detailed debris at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with action, debris, and smoke to convey chaos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Fiery orange and yellow (explosion and light source).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and teal blue (character's clothing and shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center fading to darker, desaturated tones in the peripheral debris.
paletteRestrictions: Limited use of cool tones for shadow depth

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Arched, heavy-weight display lettering with irregular, hand-drawn edges.
letterConstructionRules: Letters follow a curved path along the top of the frame.
Thick black outer strokes with a secondary inner highlight stroke.
Integration of symbols (like crosses or icons) into letterforms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' or 'O' may be replaced with character-themed icons like a clown face.

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the top of the explosion

treatment.fill: gradient or flat color with texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy display title with a smaller, cleaner sans-serif for secondary credits.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the urban, gritty street aesthetic of the illustration.
Captures the aggressive and chaotic energy of the scene.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a comic-style illustration of a red-haired clown in a red tracksuit leaping toward the camera. Behind him is a massive, detailed orange and yellow explosion in a destroyed city street with wrecked cars and rubble. Use thick black outlines and halftone textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom, hand-drawn arched lettering across the top. The letters should have a heavy black outline and a textured fill, following the curve of the explosion.

verificationChecks: Is the character's pose dynamic and leaping forward?
Does the explosion have a high-contrast, fiery color palette?
Are the outlines thick and reminiscent of comic book ink?
Is the typography arched and integrated into the top of the scene?

adjustableVariables: Level of urban destruction in the background
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the character is the clear focal point.
Check that the explosion light affects the character's shading.
Verify the debris adds to the chaos without cluttering the subject.
Confirm the text is legible despite the decorative style.
Check for consistent halftone texture application.
recipe.reuseFormula: Comic Action Hero + Urban Explosion + Arched Hand-Drawn Typography + Gritty Ink Outlines
